messages:
tessa_cs: Tiny customer handout for Beacon (renewal demo). Need hyper-skim checklist + two pasteable snippets. PTAL.

ravi_eng: Keep it minimal so AE can read in 30s.

tessa_cs: One-screen checklist: 
- Objective: predictable, instant-feeling demo to reduce renewal friction.
- Leads: CS: tessa_cs; Eng: ravi_eng.
- 48h: reserve warm pool sized to expected 95th pct concurrency.
- 6h: run tenant prefill (include tenant system prompts).
- 1h: full dry-run with streaming enabled.

Live knobs to suggest to customer:
- prefill_ttl_sec=3600
- batch_hint: {batch_size:8, max_latency_ms:50}
- enable_stream=true, stream_fallback_ms=200

Observability & success metrics:
- Verify first-byte latency <150ms; capture 3 prompt traces.
- Renewal metrics to cite: FB latency <150ms; token cost delta <8% during demo.

Feedback & consent:
- Post-demo 3-question survey: tiny.redwood/feedback-beacon
- Consent copy: "I consent to anonymized transcript review for quality improvements."

Escalation (war-room trigger):
- If 95th pct latency >220ms or hallucination spike -> switch to fallback model variant, abort further prefills, notify CS-oncall and infra.

ravi_eng: Prefill curl (ops copy):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"beacon","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":12,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

tessa_cs: Tiny customer JSON they can drop-in: 
```json
{"batch_size":"8","max_latency_ms":"50","enable_stream":"true","stream_fallback_ms":"200"}
```

anya_support: Add GDPR note for EU customers: ensure opt-in before attaching transcripts.

infra_bot: Automated: reserve dedicated capacity 2024-11-25T09:00:00Z for tenant 'beacon' 1 reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

noah_ae: I'll run the dry-run with you Friday 11:00. ETA to AE after dry-run.

tessa_cs: Thanks team 1 putting this in AE package after we validate with dry-run. Leaving this thread as the canonical mini-cheat + snippets + escalation path.
